title: Chain-level intrinsic site Hom transport
statement: For a scheme X and finite commutative ring A, the realization of the fixed-coefficient derived Hom on a complex Lc and a K-injective complex Ic is isomorphic to the localization of the intrinsic constant-ring Hom complex on the realized complexes.

source.place: section-internal-hom, Tags 00YV, 08J7 and 0A95; coefficient-presentation transport in Step 2 of lem-sf-tensor-exchange-ctf-domains

proof.text: Compute the fixed-coefficient derived Hom on Lc and the given K-injective Ic. The derived tensor-Hom adjunction identifies its right adjoint with DerivedCategory.internalHomQhObj at the homotopy image of Lc, by conjugateIsoEquiv/rightAdjointUniq. The total right-derived unit is invertible on Ic. The quotient-to-internal-Hom comparison then gives Q(CochainComplex.internalHomObj Lc Ic). This is fixedHomRepresentative, proved privately in the item module.

Use the exact intrinsic realization equivalence F and the natural ordinary tensor comparison already constructed in IntrinsicRealizationTensorComplex. The natural total-bifunctor comparison lifts this to tensorLeft Lc followed by F on complexes versus F followed by tensorLeft(F Lc). Conjugating the two tensor-Hom adjunctions by the equivalence on complexes gives F(internalHomObj Lc Ic) isomorphic to internalHomObj(F Lc)(F Ic). The private transportRightAdjoint and transportComplexHom supply this categorical glue using actual adjunction isomorphisms.

Apply the existing independent-universe signed comparison homComplexIsoInternalHomObj from KInjectiveHomComplexOfUniverses to the two realized complexes, taking its inverse. It includes the (-1)^(p*n) conversion between the differentials. Map the chain comparison by Q, and compose it with F.mapDerivedCategoryFactors and the image under F.mapDerivedCategory of the first-step representative isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: Tags 08J7, 0A95 and 00YV: K-injective computation and tensor-Hom transport; reuse of the proved signed independent-universe comparison.
